exposure: lack of iron-folate supplementation during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 414 women who underwent caesarean sections in public hospitals in the West Gojjam zone, Ethiopia.
finding: The overall prevalence of postpartum anemia among caesarean-section women was 32.85%, and it was significantly associated with a history of blood loss, pre-delivery hemoglobin level < 11 g/dl, lack of iron-folate supplementation during pregnancy, and non-adherence to iron-folate supplementation.
